lines.zh: 我爬过冰面，留下一道痕。
lines.en: I crawl over the ice, leaving a trail.
My body is bitterly cold.
Six little legs move together.

lines.zh: 我在雪里钻出一个小洞。
lines.en: I bore a small hole in the snow.
Not fast. The snow is deep.
Frost has formed on my back.
I know this frozen ground.
I crawl along a crevasse.
My segments click softly.
Snow on me does not melt.

lines.zh: 我蹭过一块石头，冰碴掉了。
lines.en: I brush a stone and ice chips fall.
I head for the colder ground.
I go behind the drift.
Each step sinks a little.
I drag a thin long trail.
Under the snow there is only stone and frost.
I lie on the snow, still.
Cold radiates off me.
I wait for my heat to fall.
The snow is bright.
I keep still, like a piece of ice.
Wind blows snow onto me.
I listen under the snow.
There is a white layer on my shell.
I work my jaws slowly.

lines.zh: 雪原上，源石虫一拱一拱。
lines.en: On the snowfield, the oriworm inches along.
I am holding that breath in.
Water murmurs faintly under the ice.
Your breath comes out white.
You are cold too, are you not.
I am three paces from you.
You step on the ice. It cracks loudly.
On the Ice Spikes, I burst.
There is meltwater on your cuff.
Warm things should keep their distance.
Your warmth rises too high.
My shell is cold.
Dare you reach for me.
A crack has opened in my shell.
I bury my head in the snow.
Half my cold bled away.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我受得住，冰壳还厚。
lines.en: I can take this; my ice shell is thick.
I pulled back half a foot.
Half a segment has come loose.
Something other than snow fell there.
I move slowly.
Still able to crawl.
The shell cracked, but the ice is still thick.

lines.zh: 雪原上四只一起爬，就是冰爆。
lines.en: Four of us crawling the snowfield make the ice burst.
That does not smell like food.
Lower the iron, I cannot reach it.
I have crawled over.
This thing is cold.
Iron makes me strong.
I took a bite.
Give me more.

lines.zh: 冰爆的壳，还想要一块铁。
lines.en: This ice-blast shell wants one more iron.
Ice spikes hang on my back.
You stepped on my back.
My shell is hard, and cold.
I roll to one side.
A field of claw marks in the snow.
One roll and I slip aside.
Your kick slides me away.
That left me dazed.
Do not press down on me.
I crawl past your foot.
Let me by.
Under the snow, we touched.
Its shell is whiter than mine.
We dig into the snow together.
Cold flows between us.
The brood will be buried under the ice.
We do not fight.
It burrowed into the snow and vanished.
I keep watch over this snow nest.
Snow soon covers the traces.
Claws on ice. Quiet.
I took that piece of ice.
I hold it in my jaws.
Not iron. Not interesting.
This one still holds the cold.

lines.zh: 我一点点把它挪进雪洞。
lines.en: I inch it into my snow burrow.
Too heavy to drag.
Would this freeze your hand?
I dropped it.
You dropped it.
What falls in the snow, I keep.
Warmth is approaching.
I slip into the snow-shadow at your feet.
You broke the ice.
You cracked my ice.
This ice sheet is mine.
I am gathering that cold breath.
Back off. Do not tread this snow.
Come close and I freeze you.

lines.zh: 我的身子凉得刺骨，正好伏击。
lines.en: My body is freezing cold, perfect for an ambush.
You stopped. Good.
Your warmth is too obvious.
I will freeze you in place.
I turn to face you.
You have backed onto the ice.
It is slippery here.
I shift in, bit by bit.
Frost is forming between my segments.
The cold is gathering.
Further back is water.

lines.zh: 雪地里，我贴着石头取暖。
lines.en: In the snow, I hug a stone for warmth.
You shivered.

lines.zh: 我要炸的时候会先鼓起来。
lines.en: Before I burst, I swell up first.
I have enough cold for one burst.
You broke the ice up further.
I scrape along the ground into you.
A blast of cold goes out.
The ice cracks in a patch.
The cold makes you stiffen.
My jaws clamp your ankle.
That must feel cold.
When I burst, ice shards scatter.
The cold disperses.
You are still moving.
Then I freeze you again.
Feed me iron and I grow stronger.
Cold here. Good.
The snowfield runs out of sight.
I shake the frost off my shell.
The wind is fierce.
First I dig a burrow.
The snow is loose.
I cannot smell iron.
This ice field is new.
I crawl forward slowly.
Fire melts my shell to water.
I hit the ice and my shell rings.
The water is cold. I sank.
The heat of the blast hurts me.
An arrow pins me to the ice.
Heat has seeped between my segments.
There is nothing to eat here.

lines.zh: 雷光顺着冰壳爬了一圈。
lines.en: Lightning crawls around my ice shell.
There is not even cold here.
